info.title: CRX Manage API
info.description:
The operator console's API. Every console action is one of these routes.

Every request carries four headers: CRX-Key-Id, CRX-Timestamp (unix milliseconds), CRX-Nonce (16 to 64 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -) and CRX-Signature.

CRX-Signature is the base64 Ed25519 signature, made with the key's private key, of these six lines joined by a line feed, with no line feed at the end:

CRX-MANAGE-V1, the method in capitals, the path with its query as sent (for example /api/v1/clients), the timestamp, the nonce, and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the body (of the empty string when there is no body).

A timestamp more than 120 seconds old or more than 5 seconds ahead, a nonce used before, an unknown or revoked key, or a bad signature answers 401. A key takes 60 requests a minute; past that, 429.

Writes take a JSON body of at most 8 KB (the logo, 300 KB) and an optional Idempotency-Key header, kept 24 hours.

keyId.name: CRX-Key-Id
keyId.description: The key id, mk_ followed by 16 hex characters.

nonce.name: CRX-Nonce
nonce.description: 16 to 64 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -. Used once.

signature.name: CRX-Signature
signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature of the signing message.

field.description: The body field the error is about.

bad_request.description: The request is malformed or a field is invalid. `field` names the field.

forbidden.description: The caller's role does not allow this request.

not_found.description: No such resource for this operator.

conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state.

rate_limited.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this key.

unavailable.description: The service cannot complete the request now. No change was made.

get.summary: List one client's trades, newest first.
get.description:
Role: viewer. API key scope: read or higher.

Answer: `{available: true}` with trades and `next`, the cursor of the next page or null. A trade: id, pair, side, notional, notionalCurrency, rate, valueDate, status (`pending`, `open`, `closed` or `refused`), openedAt, closedAt, and pnlUsd, the result the client's desk shows or null. Null where the client's account holds no value: side (a leg whose side the account does not show), rate, valueDate (a refused trade), openedAt (a trade still being sent), closedAt (not closed), notionalCurrency (a pair that does not parse), pnlUsd (an open trade, or no fixing yet). A client whose account data is not open to the operator answers `{available: false}` and no other field.

200.description: `{available: true}` with trades and `next`, the cursor of the next page or null. A trade: id, pair, side, notional, notionalCurrency, rate, valueDate, status (`pending`, `open`, `closed` or `refused`), openedAt, closedAt, and pnlUsd, the result the client's desk shows or null. Null where the client's account holds no value: side (a leg whose side the account does not show), rate, valueDate (a refused trade), openedAt (a trade still being sent), closedAt (not closed), notionalCurrency (a pair that does not parse), pnlUsd (an open trade, or no fixing yet). A client whose account data is not open to the operator answers `{available: false}` and no other field.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `open`, `closed` or `all`. Default: `all`. `open` leaves out `pending` and `closed` leaves out `refused`: both come with `all` alone.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time with `Z` or an offset: trades opened at or after it. In a raw URL, encode `+` as `%2B`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most trades to answer, 1 to 200. Default: 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next` value of the previous answer: the page after it.
